title: Vapouriz 50/50 Caramel Vanilla Tobacco 10ml
description: Caramel Vanilla Tobacco offers a smooth, mellow vape that combines rich, earthy Tobacco with notes of golden Caramel and soft Vanilla. The result is a subtly sweet tobacco profile with a warm, rounded character that appeals to both traditional and flavour-seeking vapers. With a 50VG/50PG blend, this e-liquid strikes a balance between flavour clarity and vapour production, making it an excellent choice for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping with pod kits, vape pens and beginner-friendly devices. Expertly crafted by Vapouriz Labs in the UK, the Vapouriz 50/50 range is designed to suit a wide variety of vape setups. This collection brings reliable quality and smooth performance to vapers seeking accessible, flavourful blends. The 50/50 mix refers to an equal balance of Vegetable Glycerine (VG) and Propylene Glycol (PG), delivering a consistent throat hit with vivid flavour. Suitable for most refillable starter kits and pod devices.
